mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS falls for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and expanding equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting corporate earnings and expanding equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue growth and expanding equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when RSAFS rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, raising wage pressures and reducing corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
